name: <form>
description: Groups related form controls and defines how their data is submitted to a server.
parameters: action — URL to submit to. method — GET or POST. enctype — encoding, e.g. multipart/form-data for file uploads.
example:
<form action="/login" method="post">
  <input type="email" name="email" />
  <button type="submit">Log in</button>
</form>
notes: Pressing Enter in a text field submits the form even without clicking the submit button.

name: <input type="text">
description: A single-line free text input field, the default input type when type is omitted.
parameters: name — key used when submitting. value — initial/current text. maxlength — max character count.

name: <input type="email">
description: A text input specialized for email addresses, with built-in format validation and an email-optimized mobile keyboard.
parameters: multiple — allows a comma-separated list of addresses.
notes: Browser validation only checks for a basic name@domain shape, not that the address actually exists.

name: <input type="password">
description: A single-line text input that masks entered characters, used for sensitive values like passwords.
notes: Masking is visual only — always transmit and store the value securely (HTTPS, hashed on the server).

name: <input type="number">
description: A numeric input with increment/decrement controls and built-in min/max/step validation.
parameters: min, max — allowed range. step — increment size.
notes: The value is always returned as a string in JS — convert with Number() before doing math.

name: <input type="checkbox">
description: A toggle control representing a boolean on/off choice, or one option among several independent selections.
notes: Unchecked checkboxes aren't included in form submission data at all.

name: <input type="radio">
description: A mutually exclusive option button; only one radio with the same name can be selected at a time.
parameters: name — groups radios together. value — value submitted when selected.
example:
<input type="radio" name="plan" value="free" checked /> Free
<input type="radio" name="plan" value="pro" /> Pro
notes: All radios in a mutually exclusive group must share the same name.

name: <input type="file">
description: Lets the user select one or more files from their device to upload.
parameters: accept — allowed file types/extensions. multiple — allows selecting several files.
notes: The enclosing <form> needs enctype="multipart/form-data" for uploaded files to actually be sent.

name: <input type="date">
description: Displays a native date picker and stores the value in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
notes: Picker appearance is controlled entirely by the browser/OS and can't be styled beyond basic CSS.

name: <input type="range">
description: A slider control for picking a numeric value within a range, when the exact number matters less than a rough position.
parameters: min, max — range bounds. step — increment size.
notes: Doesn't show its current value visually — pair it with an output element or JS listener to display it.

name: <input type="color">
description: Opens a native color picker and returns the selected color as a hex string.
notes: Always returns a 6-digit hex value, never supports alpha transparency.

name: <label>
description: Provides a caption for a form control, improving accessibility and letting a click on the label focus the associated control.
parameters: for — id of the associated form control (or wrap the control directly inside the label instead).
notes: Every form control should have an associated label — placeholder text alone isn't accessible enough.

name: <select>
description: A dropdown control for choosing one (or, with multiple, several) values from a predefined list of <option> elements.
parameters: multiple — allows selecting more than one option. size — number of visible rows.

name: <option>
description: Defines a single choice within a <select> dropdown or a <datalist>.
parameters: value — value submitted when selected. selected — pre-selects this option.
notes: If value is omitted, the option's text content is used as the submitted value.

name: <textarea>
description: A multi-line, resizable free text input field.
parameters: rows/cols — visible size. maxlength — max character count.
example: <textarea name="bio" rows="4" placeholder="Tell us about yourself"></textarea>
notes: Unlike <input>, its default value is set via inner text content, not a value attribute.

name: <button>
description: A clickable control that can submit a form, reset it, or trigger custom JavaScript, depending on its type.
parameters: type — submit (default inside a form), reset, or button (no default action).
notes: Inside a <form>, a button defaults to type="submit" — set type="button" explicitly to avoid accidental submits.

name: <fieldset>
description: Groups a set of related form controls together, typically rendered with a surrounding border.
parameters: disabled — disables every control nested inside it at once.

name: <legend>
description: Provides a caption for the contents of an enclosing <fieldset>.
notes: Must be the first child of <fieldset>.

name: required
description: Marks a form control as mandatory, blocking form submission and showing a browser validation message until it's filled in.
notes: Client-side only — always re-validate required fields on the server too.

name: pattern
description: Restricts a text-like input's valid value to one matching a given regular expression.
parameters: A JavaScript-flavored regex, without surrounding slashes.
notes: Pair it with title so the browser's default validation message explains the expected format.
